```{r}
# ----------------------------------------------------
# FASE A — Funzione ITSMe: NO alpha-shape dentro il loop
# ----------------------------------------------------
process_point_clouds_ITSMe <- function(files, source_label) {
  
  results_list <- list()
  
  for (file_path in files) {
    tryCatch({
      
      # 1) Leggi point cloud
      tree_pc <- read_tree_pc(path = file_path)   # data.frame con X,Y,Z
      
      # 2) Altezza albero
      tree_height <- max(tree_pc$Z, na.rm = TRUE) - min(tree_pc$Z, na.rm = TRUE)
      
      # 3) Classificazione CHIOMA ITSMe
      C_out     <- classify_crown_pc(pc = tree_pc)
      crown_ins <- C_out$crownpoints     # data.frame con X,Y,Z
      
      if (is.null(crown_ins) || nrow(crown_ins) < 10) {
        results_list[[length(results_list)+1]] <- data.frame(
          file_name         = basename(file_path),
          source            = source_label,
          tree_height       = tree_height,
          crown_base_height = NA,
          crown_length      = NA,
          crown_pa          = NA,
          crown_width       = NA,
          cw_cl_ratio       = NA
        )
        next
      }
      
      # 4) Crown base height & length
      crown_base_height <- min(crown_ins$Z, na.rm = TRUE)
      crown_length      <- max(crown_ins$Z) - crown_base_height
      
      # 5) Projected area ITSMe
      pa_out   <- projected_area_pc(pc = crown_ins)
      crown_pa <- pa_out$pa
      
      # 6) Crown width = diametro del cerchio equivalente
      crown_width <- 2 * sqrt(crown_pa / pi)
      
      # (opzionale) rapporto crown width / crown length
      cw_cl_ratio <- ifelse(is.finite(crown_length) & crown_length > 0,
                            crown_width / crown_length,
                            NA_real_)
      
      # ---- Salva risultati base (ITSMe-only) ----
      results_list[[length(results_list)+1]] <- data.frame(
        file_name         = basename(file_path),
        source            = source_label,
        tree_height       = tree_height,
        crown_base_height = crown_base_height,
        crown_length      = crown_length,
        crown_pa          = crown_pa,
        crown_width       = crown_width,
        cw_cl_ratio       = cw_cl_ratio
      )
      
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Errore nel file ITSMe: ", basename(file_path), "\n", e)
    })
  }
  
  bind_rows(results_list)
}
```

```{r}
process_alpha_metrics <- function(files, 
                                  source_label, 
                                  alpha_val = 0.3) {
  
  results_list <- list()
  
  for (file_path in files) {
    message("Processing (alpha): ", file_path)
    
    tryCatch({
      # 1) Leggi point cloud
      tree_pc <- read_tree_pc(path = file_path)
      
      # 2) Classificazione chioma
      C_out     <- classify_crown_pc(pc = tree_pc)
      crown_pts <- C_out$crownpoints   # data.frame con X,Y,Z
      
      # 3) Controllo minimo punti
      if (is.null(crown_pts) || nrow(crown_pts) < 4) {
        warning("Pochi punti di chioma per alpha shape nel file: ", basename(file_path))
        
        results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          file_name           = basename(file_path),
          source              = source_label,
          alpha               = alpha_val,
          n_points_crown      = ifelse(is.null(crown_pts), 0, nrow(crown_pts)),
          crown_volume_alpha  = NA_real_,
          crown_surface_alpha = NA_real_
        )
        next
      }
      
      # 4) Matrice XYZ per alpha shape
      M <- as.matrix(crown_pts[, c("X", "Y", "Z")])
      
      # 5) Alpha shape 3D
      ash <- alphashape3d::ashape3d(M, alpha = alpha_val)
      
      # 6) Volume alpha-shape
      vol <- as.numeric(alphashape3d::volume_ashape3d(ash))
      
      # 7) Superficie alpha-shape:
      #    surfaceNormals restituisce vettori normali con modulo = area del triangolo
      normals_obj <- alphashape3d::surfaceNormals(ash)
      normals_mat <- normals_obj$normals          # matrice Nx3
      tri_areas   <- sqrt(rowSums(normals_mat^2)) # modulo di ogni normale = area
      surf        <- sum(tri_areas, na.rm = TRUE)
      
      # 8) Salva risultati
      results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        file_name           = basename(file_path),
        source              = source_label,
        alpha               = alpha_val,
        n_points_crown      = nrow(crown_pts),
        crown_volume_alpha  = vol,
        crown_surface_alpha = surf
      )
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Errore nel file alpha: ", basename(file_path), "\n", e)
      
      results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        file_name           = basename(file_path),
        source              = source_label,
        alpha               = alpha_val,
        n_points_crown      = NA_integer_,
        crown_volume_alpha  = NA_real_,
        crown_surface_alpha = NA_real_
      )
    })
  }
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(results_list)
}
```

```{r}

compute_crown_sinuosity <- function(files, pop_label) {
  # files     = vettore di path ai .txt
  # pop_label = etichetta popolamento (es. "QC_TR")
  
  out_list <- list()
  
  for (fp in files) {
    message("Crown sinuosity - ", basename(fp))
    
    res <- tryCatch({
      # 1. Leggo point cloud
      pc <- read_tree_pc(fp)
      
      # 2. Estraggo la chioma
      C_out <- classify_crown_pc(pc = pc)
      crown <- C_out$crownpoints
      
      # 3. Base, tip, lunghezza chioma
      z_min <- min(crown$Z, na.rm = TRUE)
      z_max <- max(crown$Z, na.rm = TRUE)
      cl    <- z_max - z_min
      
      if (!is.finite(cl) || cl <= 0) {
        return(data.frame(
          file_name       = basename(fp),
          Pop             = pop_label,
          crown_sinuosity = NA_real_
        ))
      }
      
      frac <- 0.20  # 20% basso/alto
      
      base_pts <- crown[crown$Z <= z_min + frac * cl, ]
      tip_pts  <- crown[crown$Z >= z_max - frac * cl, ]
      
      base_pt <- c(
        X = mean(base_pts$X, na.rm = TRUE),
        Y = mean(base_pts$Y, na.rm = TRUE),
        Z = mean(base_pts$Z, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
      
      tip_pt <- c(
        X = mean(tip_pts$X, na.rm = TRUE),
        Y = mean(tip_pts$Y, na.rm = TRUE),
        Z = mean(tip_pts$Z, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
      
      axis_vec <- tip_pt - base_pt
      
      if (any(!is.finite(axis_vec)) || sum(axis_vec^2) == 0) {
        return(data.frame(
          file_name       = basename(fp),
          Pop             = pop_label,
          crown_sinuosity = NA_real_
        ))
      }
      
      # 4. Distanza di OGNI punto di chioma dall’asse ideale
      #    (distanza punto-linea 3D)
      M <- as.matrix(crown[, c("X", "Y", "Z")])
      B <- matrix(base_pt, nrow = nrow(M), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
      
      w  <- M - B
      t  <- rowSums(w * matrix(axis_vec, nrow = nrow(M), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)) /
        sum(axis_vec * axis_vec)
      P  <- B + t * matrix(axis_vec, nrow = nrow(M), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
      d  <- sqrt(rowSums((M - P)^2))
      
      d  <- d[is.finite(d)]
      
      sinu <- if (length(d) == 0) NA_real_ else mean(d)
      
      data.frame(
        file_name       = basename(fp),
        Pop             = pop_label,
        crown_sinuosity = sinu
      )
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Errore su ", basename(fp), ": ", e$message)
      data.frame(
        file_name       = basename(fp),
        Pop             = pop_label,
        crown_sinuosity = NA_real_
      )
    })
    
    out_list[[length(out_list) + 1]] <- res
  }
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(out_list)
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

compute_crown_displacement <- function(files, pop_label) {
  
  out_list <- vector("list", length(files))
  
  for (i in seq_along(files)) {
    fp <- files[i]
    message("Crown displacement - ", basename(fp))
    
    res <- tryCatch({
      pc <- read_tree_pc(path = fp)
      
      C_out <- classify_crown_pc(pc = pc)
      crown <- C_out$crownpoints
      
      # Se la chioma non c'è o è troppo scarsa → NA
      if (is.null(crown) || nrow(crown) < 10) {
        return(data.frame(
          file_name          = basename(fp),
          Pop                = pop_label,
          crown_displacement = NA_real_
        ))
      }
      
      z_min <- min(crown$Z, na.rm = TRUE)
      z_max <- max(crown$Z, na.rm = TRUE)
      cl    <- z_max - z_min
      
      if (!is.finite(cl) || cl <= 0) {
        return(data.frame(
          file_name          = basename(fp),
          Pop                = pop_label,
          crown_displacement = NA_real_
        ))
      }
      
      frac <- 0.20  # 20% basso / alto
      
      base_pts <- crown[crown$Z <= z_min + frac * cl, ]
      tip_pts  <- crown[crown$Z >= z_max - frac * cl, ]
      
      base_xy <- c(
        X = mean(base_pts$X, na.rm = TRUE),
        Y = mean(base_pts$Y, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
      
      tip_xy <- c(
        X = mean(tip_pts$X, na.rm = TRUE),
        Y = mean(tip_pts$Y, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
      
      if (any(!is.finite(c(base_xy, tip_xy)))) {
        crown_disp <- NA_real_
      } else {
        crown_disp <- sqrt((tip_xy["X"] - base_xy["X"])^2 +
                           (tip_xy["Y"] - base_xy["Y"])^2)
      }
      
      data.frame(
        file_name          = basename(fp),
        Pop                = pop_label,
        crown_displacement = crown_disp
      )
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Errore su ", basename(fp), ": ", e$message)
      data.frame(
        file_name          = basename(fp),
        Pop                = pop_label,
        crown_displacement = NA_real_
      )
    })
    
    out_list[[i]] <- res
  }
  
  bind_rows(out_list)
}

FS_HF_dis <- compute_crown_displacement(Fs_Hf_files, pop_label = "FS_HF")
write_csv(FS_HF_dis, file.path(output, "FS_HF_dis.csv"))

QC_TR_dis <- compute_crown_displacement(Qc_Tr_files, pop_label = "QC_TR")
write_csv(QC_TR_dis, file.path(output, "QC_TR_dis.csv"))

QC_CP_dis <- compute_crown_displacement(Qc_Cp_files, pop_label = "QC_TR")
write_csv(QC_CP_dis, file.path(output, "QC_CP_dis.csv"))

PM_R_dis  <- compute_crown_displacement(Pm_R_files,  pop_label = "PM_R")
write_csv(PM_R_dis,  file.path(output, "PM_R_dis.csv"))
```
